description: This file manages LINE account resolution, including token and secret retrieval, account listing, and default account selection within a larger openclaw plugin SDK project.

methods.name: readFileIfExists
methods.description: Reads a secret file if it exists, using tryReadSecretFileSync.

methods.name: resolveToken
methods.description: Resolves the LINE channel access token from account config, file, environment, or defaults.

methods.name: resolveSecret
methods.description: Resolves the LINE channel secret from account config, file, environment, or defaults.

methods.name: resolveLineAccount
methods.description: Resolves a LINE account configuration, including token, secret, and other settings.

methods.name: listLineAccountIds
methods.description: Lists all LINE account IDs configured in the system.

methods.name: resolveDefaultLineAccountId
methods.description: Determines the default LINE account ID based on configuration and availability.

methods.name: normalizeAccountId
methods.description: Normalizes an account ID using shared normalization logic.
